user.title: New recording profile
user.description: A profile defines which cams record into which folder and when. A cam may be in several profiles but never records in two at once (first come, first served). Without trigger and time window the profile starts manually only. Time window/sun only: records continuously in that window. With triggers (e.g. motion sensor): records while any is 'on'. In the file name pattern, cam, kuerzel and profil in curly braces stand for name, short code and profile; plus date/time with %CCYY %MM %DD %hh %mm %ss. The next step picks the subfolder.
